question: What must an Express Entry employment / reference letter contain?

claims.text: The employment reference or experience letter from the employer must be an official document printed on company letterhead.
claims.quote: should be an official document printed on company letterhead

claims.text: The employment reference letter must include the applicant's name, company contact information including address, telephone number, and email address, and the name, title, and signature of the immediate supervisor or personnel officer.
claims.quote: must include the applicant’s name, the company’s contact information [address, telephone number and email address], and the name, title and signature of the immediate supervisor or personnel officer at the company

claims.text: The employment reference letter should indicate all positions held while employed at the company.
claims.quote: should indicate all positions held while employed at the company

claims.text: The employment reference letter must include details such as job title, duties and responsibilities, job status if current, dates worked for the company, number of work hours per week, and annual salary plus benefits.
claims.quote: must include the following details: job title, duties and responsibilities, job status (if current job), dates worked for the company, number of work hours per week and annual salary plus benefits

basis: Applicant submitted an employment reference letter document for case 53cd21daf759f2e2a12a90911556b337 supporting declared skilled work experience at <employer>.
